transcript.en: A grey picture is not a thing with a name. On the computer it is a grid of numbers, one brightness in each cell. Today: pictures as grids, and what a small filter actually mixes. A grey image is one grid. A colour image is three, and each cell is a brightness, not an object. A three by three filter lies on the picture and multiplies nine cells. It writes that sum as the new pixel. An upright-edge filter lights the sides of walls and doors. A blur averages neighbours, and neither knows it is looking at a face. Here is one position of the filter. Nine multiplications become one number, and the name of the object is not in that number. Quick check! A grey picture on a computer is which of these? A grid of numbers. Names, if they appear, come from many layers, not from one filter. In the app, open the convolution lab. Slide an edge filter and a blur, and say what each new picture shows. Your turn. Does a three by three filter already know it is looking at a face? Remember this. A filter mixes neighbours. It does not name what it sees. Try it on paper tonight. Sketch a three by three edge filter and compute one output pixel.

title.en: A picture is a grid of numbers

body.en: Read a grey image as a matrix and a colour image as three. A 3×3 filter slides over the picture: at each spot it multiplies each of the nine cells by its weight, adds them up, and writes the sum into a new grid. An upright-edge filter lights the sides of walls and doors. A blur averages. A sharpen filter makes each pixel stand out from its neighbours. In a real vision network nobody picks these nine numbers: training learns them, like any other weight. Pooling keeps the strongest cell in a small block and throws the rest away. Nothing here has recognised a face. Open the convolution lab and say which filter did which job.
body.ar: اقرأ الصورة الرمادية مصفوفة والملونة ثلاثًا. وينزلق المرشّح ٣×٣ فوق الصورة: عند كل موضع يضرب كل خانة من الخانات التسع في وزنها، ثم يجمعها، ويكتب المجموع في شبكة جديدة. ومرشّح الحواف القائمة يضيء جوانب الجدران والأبواب. والطمس يأخذ المتوسط. ومرشّح الإبراز يجعل كل بكسل يبرز عن جيرانه. وفي شبكة رؤية حقيقية لا يختار أحد هذه الأرقام التسعة: يتعلّمها التدريب مثل أي وزن آخر. والتجميع يبقي أقوى خانة في مربع صغير ويرمي الباقي. ولا شيء هنا تعرّف على وجه. افتح معمل المرشّحات وقل أي مرشّح فعل أي عمل.

body.en: A real vision network stacks blocks. Each block is a convolution (its filters), then an activation such as ReLU, which keeps a positive response and turns a negative one into 0, then pooling, which keeps the strongest response in each small block. Each part throws something away: the filters keep only what their weights look for, ReLU drops the negative responses, and pooling drops exactly where a feature was. After several blocks, the last layers turn what is left into a score. The detector in this lab skips all of that, so the miss is easy to see. It is the average of its training faces, and here there is one drawing, with the eyes close together. The test has a close-set face, a wider drawing that is still a face, and a box that is not. The score is how closely a picture matches the average, and the line, 0.55, is the same for all of them. The close-set face scores 0.894 and the box 0, which is right for a box. The wide face scores 0.548: just under the line, so it is missed. That is the point of a face-detection lab without anyone’s photograph: a detector repeats the shapes it was shown, and a test on only those shapes hides the miss.

transcript.en: The blob's code is two numbers: where its brightness sits. Decoding paints a blob there, and it does not keep every pixel. Today: squeeze a picture into a short code, and what a nudge invents. Encoding finds the centre of the brightness. Decoding paints a new blob at that code. Leave the code and the decode is close. Move it and you invent a new blob, not a repair of the old pixels. Two numbers are a summary of this brightness. They are not a map of meaning, and they are not a photograph. Here the two numbers pick a place. The painted blob follows them, and the original pixels do not come back. Quick check! The two-number code of the blob is which of these? Where the brightness sits. The exact pixels were never stored. In the app, open the code lab. Leave the sliders, then move one, and say when the decode stopped being a rebuild. Your turn. Does nudging the code repair the original pixels? Remember this. A short code rebuilds a summary. A moved code is a new picture. Try it tonight. body.en: An autoencoder squeezes and rebuilds. In this lab the squeeze is the centre of the brightness, two numbers, and the rebuild is a blob painted there. Even with the code untouched, the two bright specks are lost: two numbers cannot hold them. Nudge either number and the blob moves, and the difference from the original grows, because the code never stored every pixel. A real autoencoder learns its encoder and decoder by making the rebuild close to the original; in this lab both are fixed by hand. A variational version learns a cloud of codes, not one point, so a new code sampled from the cloud still decodes to a sensible picture. Two numbers are not a map of meaning. They are a summary of this brightness.

transcript.en: Three ideas invent a picture. One rebuilds from a code, one tries to fool a judge, and one removes a little noise at a time. Today: a contest, a denoise step, and why one step is not a finished picture. A generative contest trains one network to fool another. The contest can collapse, and a sharp sample is still not a proof. Diffusion adds noise until the picture is gone. Then it learns a step that removes a little, and repeats that step. The lab takes one step on a plus sign, pulling each pixel toward black or white. Heavy noise leaves the plus unfinished. Put the three names in a row before you admire any sample. Rebuild, contest, and denoise are different losses. Quick check! Which idea removes a little noise at a time? Diffusion. One step in the lab is the idea, not a trained generator. In the app, open the denoise lab. Set the noise in the middle and at the far right, and say what one step did not restore. Your turn. Is a picture from a generator evidence of what it shows? Remember this. Three different losses. A generated picture is not evidence. Try it tonight. Write the three methods and one failure each.
transcript.ar: تلات أفكار بيخترعوا صورة. واحد بيعيد البناء من رمز، وواحد بيحاول يخدع مميِّز، وواحد بيشيل شوية ضوضاء في كل مرة. النهارده: منافسة، وخطوة تشيل الضوضاء، وليه الخطوة الواحدة مش صورة خلصانة. المنافسة التوليدية بتدرّب شبكة تخدع شبكة تانية. والمنافسة ممكن تنهار، والعيّنة الحادة برضه مش دليل. الانتشار بيضيف ضوضاء لحد ما الصورة تختفي. وبعدين يتعلّم خطوة تشيل شوية، ويكرّر الخطوة دي. المعمل بياخد خطوة واحدة على علامة زائد، ويسحب كل بكسل ناحية الأسود أو الأبيض. والضوضاء التقيلة بتسيب الزائد مش خلصان. حط التلات أسماء في صف قبل ما تعجب بأي عيّنة. إعادة البناء، والمنافسة، وإزالة الضوضاء، تلات خسائر مختلفة. سؤال سريع! أي فكرة بتشيل شوية ضوضاء في كل مرة؟ الانتشار. الخطوة الواحدة في المعمل هي الفكرة، مش مولّد متدرّب. في التطبيق، افتح معمل إزالة الضوضاء. خلّي الضوضاء في النص وفي أقصى اليمين، وقول الخطوة الواحدة مرجّعتش إيه. دورك. صورة من مولّد دليل على اللي بتبيّنه؟ افتكر كده. تلات خسائر مختلفة. والصورة المتولّدة مش دليل. جرّبها الليلة. اكتب التلات طرق وفشل واحد لكل طريقة.

body.en: Three ways to invent a picture. An autoencoder rebuilds from a short code. A GAN (generative adversarial network) trains two networks against each other: a generator invents pictures, and a discriminator judges whether a picture is real or made up. The contest can collapse, for example when the generator finds a few pictures that fool the discriminator and makes only those. Diffusion destroys a picture with noise and learns a step that removes a little; repeat it many times and a picture can return. The denoise lab takes one step on a plus sign, pulling each pixel toward black or white. With noise near the middle, the step brings the picture closer to the plus. With heavy noise, one step leaves black and white speckles and ends further from the plus than before. A generated picture is not evidence of what it shows.
body.ar: ثلاث طرق لاختراع صورة. المرمّز التلقائي يعيد البناء من رمز قصير. والشبكة التوليدية الخصمية (GAN) تدرّب شبكتين إحداهما ضد الأخرى: مولّد يخترع الصور، ومميّز يحكم هل الصورة حقيقية أم مخترعة. وقد تنهار المنافسة، كأن يجد المولّد صورًا قليلة تخدع المميّز فلا يصنع غيرها. والانتشار يدمّر الصورة بالضوضاء ويتعلّم خطوة تزيل قليلًا منها، وإذا كُرّرت مرات كثيرة فقد تعود صورة. ومعمل إزالة الضوضاء يأخذ خطوة واحدة على علامة زائد، فيسحب كل بكسل نحو الأسود أو الأبيض. ومع ضوضاء قرب الوسط تقرّب الخطوة الصورة من علامة الزائد. ومع ضوضاء كثيفة تترك الخطوة الواحدة نقاطًا سوداء وبيضاء متناثرة، وتنتهي أبعد عن علامة الزائد مما كانت. والصورة المولَّدة ليست دليلًا على ما تعرضه.

         [9, 0, 9],

explain.en: The sum is 8 × 9 + 0 = 72, and 72 ÷ 9 = 8: the blur pulls the dark centre toward its bright neighbours.

explain.en: This pooling keeps the strongest response, 5 (max pooling). Average pooling, another kind, would give 2.75, and no kind of pooling keeps the sum, 11. Either way, where in the block the 5 was is thrown away.
